{{Quote|In his resignation letter to the Emperor, Holleck cited failing health and a desire to leave Chandrila for his native Ganthel as his reasons for retirement.|A news report by Coruscant Daily Newsfeed|<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|7|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
'''Ganthel''' was a celestial body<ref name="GNN" /> located in the [[Ganthel system/Legends|Ganthel system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Grandon Holleck]], a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the Bormea [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]],<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Ganthel.<ref name="GNN" /> After [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] forced Holleck's retirement,<ref name="SoR" /> a news report issued by [[Coruscant Daily Newsfeed/Legends|Coruscant Daily Newsfeed]] on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[1 ABY/Legends|36:8:4]] claimed that Holleck had cited in a resignation letter to Palpatine his desire to relocate from Chandrila to Ganthel as one of the reasons for his retirement.<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ganthel was introduced by [[Paul Sudlow]] in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|seventh issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', which was published in [[August]] [[1995]].<ref name="GNN" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ganthel [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
